mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (measured by low unemployment rate) combined with strong consumer spending (measured by high residential sales and finance) indicates robust economic conditions that boost corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of low UNRATE (<5.0%) and high RSAFS (>350000) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, a decline in HOUST fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the HOUST decline signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to produce positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0%, it signals a severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when UNRATE > 10.0%, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate combined with high unemployment rate indicates an active monetary stimulus response to a weak labor market, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of declining FEDFUNDS and UNRATE > 9.5% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a CPI reading above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that forces the central bank to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, CPIAUCSL > 2.5% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the CPI signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
